# logos wasm back-edge stride fires every 4096 latch traversals: over
# exactly 40960 loop iterations the latch is traversed 40960 times, so
# the counter fires 10 times, including the exit-edge traversal before
# the loop condition fails. A peer counting scheduler wakeups observes
# exactly 10 under the strictly alternating cooperative schedule, and
# a lost stride collapses its count.
[!exec:node] skip 'node not in PATH'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOOS=wasip1
env GOARCH=wasm

logos build -o $WORK/exe.wasm .
exec node run.mjs $WORK/exe.wasm
stdout '^yields 10$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/stridecount

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
	"sync/atomic"
)

const N = 40960

var progress atomic.Int64

//go:noinline
func spin(c chan int) {
	acc := 0
	for i := 0; i < N; i++ {
		acc = acc*3 + i
		progress.Store(int64(i))
	}
	progress.Store(N)
	c <- acc
}

//go:noinline
func count(res chan int) {
	for progress.Load() < 4000 {
		runtime.Gosched()
	}
	n := 0
	for progress.Load() < N {
		n++
		runtime.Gosched()
	}
	res <- n
}

func main() {
	c := make(chan int, 1)
	res := make(chan int, 1)
	go spin(c)
	go count(res)
	acc := <-c
	n := <-res
	fmt.Println("acc", acc&1023)
	fmt.Println("yields", n)
}

-- run.mjs --
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { WASI } from 'node:wasi';

const wasi = new WASI({ version: 'preview1', args: [], env: {}, returnOnExit: true });
const mod = await WebAssembly.compile(readFileSync(process.argv[2]));
const inst = await WebAssembly.instantiate(mod, wasi.getImportObject());
process.exitCode = wasi.start(inst);
